title: Heat-spreader interface authoring through Wright
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Heat-spreader comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved heat-spreader workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Create an interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface. Enter Heat-spreader candidate comparison as the Interface title and request a reusable comparison with shared inputs, results, findings and review controls. Click Create interface.

manualSteps.label: Preview
manualSteps.instruction: Wait for Preview ready, then click Open preview and inspect the read-only interface.

manualSteps.label: Save
manualSteps.instruction: Return to the common working tab and click Save interface.

manualSteps.label: Open saved interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved interface. Confirm it opens in a Wright workspace tab on the existing run.

steps.label: Visible interface creation
steps.summary: Wright is creating the tailored interface using its actual configured default model.
steps.action: Enter Interface title: Heat-spreader candidate comparison. Request: Create a reusable heat-spreader engineering comparison using the supplied reference template and current interaction contract. The layout must work across runs without depending on output filenames or the first run ID. Keep the supplied manifest identities. Use public Wright components and ResultRepresentation for supported data. Show actual progress, all current result cards arranged for comparing the two candidates, and pending findings/review. Use snapshot data and the template callbacks for exact evidence/navigation. Use shared input/readiness and pending-interaction controls, plus exact result/assessment/block navigation. Do not add native protocols, measurements, engineering verdicts or execution. Return the required source/manifest JSON immediately.. Click Create interface.
controls: How should this interface help the user?
steps.expected: Accepted job and visible generation progress.
steps.actual: Actual interface job accepted; creation progress visible.
